seo_description: Licensed, consent-based road condition data for road agencies, mapping and autonomous-vehicle teams, and insurers.
title: Fresh road data, collected with consent
intro: Lanevia licenses road-condition detections confirmed by multiple cameras. Every record traces back to an active driver consent and a signed license, so your compliance team can say yes.

segments.name: Road agencies
segments.use: Find active work zones and closures across your network, updated daily.

segments.name: Mapping and autonomous vehicles
segments.use: Keep maps current and train on real winter and work-zone conditions.

segments.name: Insurers
segments.use: Understand road-level risk by segment and month.
segments.access: Aggregate road data only, never driver scores. Claim evidence is a separate partner program.

segments.name: Government requests
segments.access: Only with formal legal process, and every request is logged

view_text: This is the exact shape of the buyer feed: road segment, date, event type, how many cameras confirmed it, and average confidence. No customer, device or clip IDs.
partners_text: Separate from road data licensing. Policyholders can let one partner insurer pull their locked incident clip when they file a claim, in exchange for a discount you set.
partners_points: Per policy and per claim: a claim number and loss time are required for every pull.
Only clips locked within the agreed window around the reported loss, up to 72 hours.
Every clip comes with a SHA-256 fingerprint recorded at upload, for authenticity checks.
No live feeds, trips, location history or driving scores. Customers can revoke access at any time.

launch.focus: Commuters, with the state DOT as our first buyer for work-zone and closure data, plus winter road conditions.
Autonomous-vehicle and mapping buyers, once Phase 1 proves our consent and de-identification controls.

cta_text: Tell us your use case, the area you cover and the data level you need.
